title: Chess vs Checkers
summary: Tony's chess army vs Fairy-Stockfish's 16 checkers pieces in a compressed setup on both square colours. Checkers men move one square diagonally forward and capture by jumping. Because jumps can't land off the board, edge squares are safe; Tony runs his queen down the h-file and eats the army (win ~3:08). He then plays an actual online game of checkers (opponents quit twice, ~4:57 and ~8:34).
rules: Opponent: 16 checkers men in a compressed setup on Black's first ranks, occupying both colours (instead of 12 on dark squares).

Checker: moves 1 square diagonally forward; captures by jumping diagonally over an adjacent enemy to the empty square beyond (multi-jumps allowed, inferred from checkers); a jump that would land off-board is impossible, so pieces on the edge can't be captured by a jump onto the edge.
Checker reaching the far rank becomes a checkers king (moves/jumps diagonally both ways).
Chess side wins by capturing all checkers pieces; checkers side wins by checkmating or capturing the chess king.
win_condition: Eliminate every checkers piece (lose if your king is captured/mated).

board.theme_notes: green/cream chess board with black checkers discs; second segment uses a real red/black checkers board on green felt
